appearance.description: Theme and display language. Changes apply immediately.

shortcuts.description: Click a shortcut, then press the keys you want. Backspace or Delete clears it; Escape cancels.

terminal.description: Typography for the integrated terminal. Changes apply immediately.
terminal.fontFamilyHint: Leave blank to use the built-in monospace stack.
terminal.lineHeightHint: A multiplier from 0.8 to 3.0; 1.2 is the default.

defaultFileManager.description: Register dae to open folders from the operating system.
defaultFileManager.unsupported: This platform does not expose a default file manager setting.
defaultFileManager.statusDefault: dae is the default file manager.
defaultFileManager.statusRegistered: dae is registered. Finish choosing it in system settings.
defaultFileManager.statusNotDefault: dae is not the default file manager.

default_manager.cannot_unset_macos: macOS does not allow an app to remove itself as the default. Choose another app in Finder settings to change it.
default_manager.finish_in_system_settings: Windows needs you to confirm dae as the default in the system settings page that just opened.
